title: Your Skull Has a Hole That Seals Shut After Birth 😱
hook_text: Your head was open at birth
script: Doctors still can't fully explain why it closes when it does. You were born with a gap in your skull — the anterior fontanelle, a soft diamond-shaped opening right at the top of your head. It lets your brain expand 60% in the first year of life. Close too early, before 3 months, and the brain gets crushed. Close too late, and infection gets in. It seals itself — no signal, no trigger anyone has pinpointed. What tells your skull exactly when to close? And that's how.
search_summary: Human fontanelle soft spot on baby skull closes between 12 and 18 months with no known trigger signal.
comment_question: If it closes too early OR too late, you're in danger — how does it know the right moment? 🤯
